title: Extra Credit Share for Repeated Northgate Appointment Moves
content:
**Northgate Store and Online Orders — missed-appointment extra for Northgate moves.** On the missed-appointment credit of a Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery order, the number of Northgate moves is the order's reschedule count less the number of the customer's own confirmed reschedule requests on the order, and it adds a share of the large-item delivery fee charged:

| Northgate moves recorded on the order | Extra percentage |
|---|---|
| three or more | 40 percent |
| exactly two | 20 percent |
| a single move | nothing |

**Hypothetical record.** A reschedule count of 4 with 1 confirmed customer request is 3 Northgate moves and adds 40 percent; a count of 3 with 1 confirmed request is 2 moves and adds 20 percent; a count of 2 with 1 confirmed request is a single move and adds nothing.
